# game/projects/Dark In 2/CMakeLists.txt  (auto-generated by CWZ Editor)
# Produces:
#   Dark In 2 — Game executable (boots to MenuState)
#
# CWZEditor is engine-level and is not redefined here.

file(GLOB_RECURSE ALL_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "src/*.cpp")
file(GLOB_RECURSE HEADERS     CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "include/*.hpp")

set(TARGET_NAME "DarkIn2")

add_executable("${TARGET_NAME}" ${ALL_SOURCES} ${HEADERS})

target_include_directories("${TARGET_NAME}" PRIVATE include src)
target_link_libraries("${TARGET_NAME}" PRIVATE CWZEngine)

if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options("${TARGET_NAME}" PRIVATE
    /W4 /permissive- /Zc:preprocessor /Zc:__cplusplus /bigobj
    $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:/Od>)
  target_link_options("${TARGET_NAME}" PRIVATE $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:/INCREMENTAL>)
endif()

set_target_properties("${TARGET_NAME}" PROPERTIES
  RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY         "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin"
  RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG   "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/Debug"
  RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/Release")

# FMOD dependencies (global targets defined in game/CMakeLists.txt)
if(TARGET CopyFmod)
  add_dependencies("${TARGET_NAME}" CopyFmod)
endif()
if(TARGET CopyFmodDll)
  add_dependencies("${TARGET_NAME}" CopyFmodDll)
endif()
if(TARGET CopySharedAssets)
  add_dependencies("${TARGET_NAME}" CopySharedAssets)
endif()

# Project-specific assets
set(COPY_ASSETS_TARGET "CopyDarkIn2Assets")
add_custom_target(${COPY_ASSETS_TARGET}
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/$<CONFIG>/projects/Dark In 2"
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/$<CONFIG>/assets"
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
    "${GAME_SHARED_ASSETS_DIR}/fonts" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/$<CONFIG>/projects/Dark In 2/assets/fonts"
  COMMENT "Copying Dark In 2 assets" VERBATIM)

if(TARGET CopySharedAssets)
  add_dependencies(${COPY_ASSETS_TARGET} CopySharedAssets)
endif()
add_dependencies("${TARGET_NAME}" ${COPY_ASSETS_TARGET})

source_group(TREE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src"     PREFIX "Source Files" FILES ${ALL_SOURCES})
source_group(TREE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include" PREFIX "Header Files" FILES ${HEADERS})
